judge_verdict.reasons_for_rejection: The evaluation plan fails to address critical structural and anatomical errors present in the image. Specifically: 1) The 'fusion' artifact on the left is actually a severe 'structural collapse' where two elephants merge into a single body with mismatched heads/legs; the current plan treats this as a boundary issue rather than a biological impossibility. 2) The Lion's front paws exhibit significant anatomical errors (polydactyly/melting), which the Perceptual Quality Auditor is ill-equipped to rigorously audit compared to the Animal Pose Auditor. 3) The Fine-Grained Classifier is misapplied; it cannot validate specific morphological checkpoints (e.g., 'twin-domed skull') which require segmentation or detailed visual inspection, not just class probability.

suggestions.point: Replace Fine-Grained Classifier for morphological checkpoint validation
